debugData.name: Namaqualand stones 01 (scatter rocks)
debugData.description: Poly Haven namaqualand_stones_01 (CC0, polyhaven.com/a/namaqualand_stones_01), decimated by devTools/toolkit/buildNatureRocks.ts for the scatter (p308 D5): five sandstone pebbles of 7-14 cm at 80 triangles each (StoneA-E: namaqualandStones01/StoneA, …), and three of them scaled ×4 into rocks of 41-59 cm at 400 triangles (RockA-C), each piece's base centre at its origin; positions, normals and UVs, no material (its texture set namaqualandStones01 through rockScatterNamaqualandStones01). Lossless: a scatter draws its items without their nodes, where a quantized encode puts its scale.
